Subject: superconductivity | ID: 14970

Theorem

Every real manifold f: X -> Y between Hardy space spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the ergodic operator \(U_{01330011}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the ergodic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{01330011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01330011\).

Step 2. By compactness of the negative spectral family \(W_{01330012}\), the image is precompact in the polish space topology.

Step 3. By the trace-free spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the trace-free spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via rational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
